profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer || JPMorgan Chase
profile.summary:
Over 15+ years of solid Software Engineering expertise with architectural experience and DevOps hands-on skills. Deep knowledge and experience in Security & Cryptography, designing security models, authentication protocols, and policies for application protection, security testing, and implementing cryptographic architectures to secure applications using OSS & proprietary tech stacks such as SSO, SAML, ADFS, and OWASP Top 10.

Web development using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node, and JHipster. Excellent experience with JSON, XML, XSL, XSD, XSLT, and XML parsing using OSS. Worked extensively with open-source frameworks including Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Apache Kafka, Spark, Lucene, and Elasticsearch. Strong technical skills in Oracle 19c, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis.

Deep understanding of Application Performance Management and Profiling, Testing, and Analytics tools such as Datadog, Sentry.io, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, ELK Stack, JUnit, Selenium, JMeter, and Cypress.

Experience across multiple operating systems, including Windows and Linux (Alpine, CentOS, RHEL, and Ubuntu). Able to work on-prem and in the cloud, with knowledge and hands-on experience using AWS (EC2, CLI, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, and more). Strong problem-solving skills and solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using Agile methodology.

Specialties: IT Services / IT Consulting, Streaming & Media Entertainment, Marketing Sites, Research & Development.

positions.title: Sr Java/J2EE Developer
positions.description:
As Senior Java Developer I was responsible for the analysis, design, implementation, testing and maintenance of internal and external web-based applications.  My primary areas of responsibility will include customer self-service applications and web-based interfaces into our subscriber management system for use by customer care agents.

Specifically, for the following:
	Full system life cycle development of customer self-service and customer care center applications
	Working with business analysts to develop detailed technical specifications based on functional user requirements
	Developing system and object models to support proposed architecture
	Developing conceptual, logical and physical data models
	Developing SQL queries and stored procedures for efficient data access
	Contributing to the development and execution of unit, system, integration, stress and user acceptance testing
	Addressing performance issues in an effort to ensure that all applications are highly scalable and can support high volumes of traffic
	Anticipating and resolving technical problems and solve difficult challenges with only occasional need for technical assistance from others

positions.title: Java Solution Architect
positions.description:
Pre-sales & Solutions architect I’m responsible to create, elaborate the response the RFP’s customer. Based on the business needs we understand and create the target architecture solution with the proper resources, plan, estimation effort, and cost. Engage with all LATAM customers to clarify and review the response. 
Also, I’m, responsible to customize the required “Proof of Concept” for the solution using different technologies and platforms.

To 05/2009	To 11/2009

Perform a Maintenance& Support project for a core Java application able to handle 500,000 ISO8583 transactions per customer. It uses different of protocols and management cellular services like pre-paid, post-paid service, etc. The application shall provide many options to buy/recharge “Air Time” on the pre-paid service plan and it can decide to send bills on the post-paid plan.

To 03/2009	To 05/2009

Planning, design and implement “Performance Optimization” at different Virtual Machines (Java / .NET) customer solutions. Prepare the business case; create the performance plan and execution assessment.  Create and prepare performance issues report. Re-design customer’s application applying changes to optimize the performance.

To 03/2008	To 03/2009

Core Java application able to handle 500,000 ISO8583 transactions per customer. It uses different of protocols and management cellular services like pre-paid, post-paid service, etc. The application shall provide many options to buy/recharge “Air Time” on the pre-paid service plan and it can decide to send bills on the post-paid plan.

Tools:	dynaTrace, Java, Flex, Spring, SVN, Maven Oracle 10g, JIRA, Eclipse, .NET 2.0 & 3.0, JMeter, Load Runner, JConsole, Solaris 10, Linux Servers, Windows Servers, OC4J, WebLogic, Tomcat, JBoss, SQL Server 2K and 2K5, Informix, Visio, Enterprise Architect, MS Project, UCP estimation, Alfresco, SOA, ISO8583, Open Source Frameworks, WAS 6.1, SVN, Toad.

positions.title: Sr Business Consultant
positions.description:
Apply Business Consultant Management Techniques to deliver high-quality services and products using IT platforms and tools.  I lead, coordinate and execute the Go-Live plan, apply Performance & It Security Process, Methodologies and use Proprietary Tools in order to prepare the Landscape tuning up for initial Go-live.

Functional Experience:	Applied Performance Engineer in order to tune up the applications
Applied business consultant techniques
Lead and Coordinate different teams to deliver a full IT services and applications.
Design, create and implement different business process to improve and gain quality products 

Tools:	Java, JEE, Open Source Frameworks (Spring, Axis, Eclipse, Hibernate), Application Servers, SVN, SharePoint, Web services,.NET, Oracle, SQL-Server, Sybase, SAP R/3, CRM, SRM, Net Weaver, HP IT Software Management  (aka Mercury Suite, WebInspect, Load Runner, QTP, Controller, ITG, QC), OWASP, ETL, SOA.

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description:
Put hands-on experience to design, build, integrate and deploy a web application using J2EE and .NET Technologies. Using different platforms located in a worldwide environment to achieve a consolidated process able to handle 7500 accounting weekly request.

Functional Experience:	Created and managed Vision and Scope document
Created and managed Software Requirements Specification
Created and managed Software Architecture Design Document
Created and managed Design Model Document
Lead and Coordinate the nearshore team to create a mockup and full application.

Tools:	VSS, IIS, web services, 3.0 .NET Framework, C#, Web Farms, Windows Servers, Java, J2EE and WebSphere.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Assigned to work on the “TV Promo Optimizer System”. A “service” able to create and handle a “Complex Scheduling Algorithm” based on the NBC and Universal user’s business requirement to use like a common service in SOA environment for the entire GE company.

Functional Experience:	Applied business analysis techniques
Create and managed Use Case Model
Created and managed Business Object Model
Lead and Coordinate the nearshore team to create a mockup.
Lead and Coordinate the offshore team to create detail design and complete all life cycle process.

Tools:	J2SE, J2EE, JBoss, BI, BO, DWH, Oracle, TOAD, Clear Case, Rational Rose, Requisite Pro, Rational XDE, Rational Purify, RUP, SOA, SONAR, NTI, ANT, Eclipse.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Design and Build an Adapter able to communicate and integrate a Legacy System Application on real time, using different kinds of communications protocols like UHF, 802.11, Ethernet, DSL.

Also, assigned to work on the Smart User Interface Framework. A framework able to handle three different kinds of clients, Desktop, Rugged and Mobile, to build applications on the top of it, base on the client side needs to be used as a common framework.

Functional Experience:
Applied business analysis techniques Moderated workshops: understanding the problem, identifying stakeholders, understanding needs, features Created and managed Vision and Scope document Created and managed Software Requirements Specification Created and managed Software Architecture Design Document Created and managed Design Model Document Lead and Coordinate external contractors to create corporate guidelines.

Tools:
J2SE, J2EE, Ant, CVS, Eclipse Platform, Rich Client Application, SWT, JFaces, Workbench, PDE, Together, JBuilder, Maven, JNI, C++, Linux.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer for Integrated and development JAVA application for Eldorado. Participated in the Knowledge transfer for ElDorado. Analysis, Design, and Development a client-server application for the Health Care Market using Java swing components, and Legacy System. Responsible for Developed GUI and XML transactions for interoperability of the application. Prepared user documentation and guides.

Functional Experience:
Development a Health Care Application using Java GUI, like AWT and Swing components and Integration with Legacy Systems

Tools:
J2SE, Swing, AWT, XML, Windows Professional, Linux, PostgreSQL, TOMCAT, Ant, CVS, Visual Source Safe and Eclipse, DB/C.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer for Integrated and development J2EE application to Hewlett-Packard.
Analysis and Design to migrate a Power builder application to J2EE. Responsible for Design and Developed View and Model Components using MVC pattern. Also created the security model, authentication protocols and policies for the application using JAVA. Prepared user documentation and guides.

Functional Experience:
Transformation of a Power builder application to J2EE

Tools:
J2EE, J2SE, JAAS, JCE, JavaScript, RUP, MVC, XML, XSL, Windows Professional, Fedora, Oracle 9i, TOAD, BEA Web Logic 8.1, Hibernate, Quartz, Struts, Ant and CVS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer to Integrate an ERP and WEB application for UNEFON (Second mobile company in Mexico). Design and Developing a Financial and Logistic Components from SAP/R3 using JCA & JCO. Responsible for Design and Developed View Components using MVC. I, also, was responsible to create the Main Component for management XML files in order to do the persistence storage mechanism into a RDBMS. Prepared user documentation and guides.

Functional Experience:
Integrated Application with SAP and WEB using Java and ABAP.

Tools:
RUP, MVC, Rational Rose, Java, XML, XSL, Windows Professional/XP, SAP/R3.

positions.title: Software Engineer and Chief of Quality Assurance
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer and Chief of Quality Assurance for an ERP (in-house application) for IFE. Design and Developing Logistic Component for an ERP for IFE. Prepared user documentation and guides. Applied PMBOK for the design process and quality assurance of ERP Application.

Functional Experience:
Use and applied methodologies for Quality Assurance

Tools:
PMBOK, RUP, MVC, Rational Rose, Java, Windows Professional/XP.
